prompt.text:
Implement JSON serialization helpers as one complete Go source file using package `solution` and only the standard library.

Export:

- `type DeviceConfig struct { Label string; Level uint8; token string }`
- `func NewDeviceConfig(label string, level uint8, token string) DeviceConfig`
- `func (c DeviceConfig) Token() string`
- `func EncodeDeviceConfig(c DeviceConfig) ([]byte, error)`
- `func DecodeDeviceConfig(data []byte) (DeviceConfig, error)`
- `func DecodeJSONObject(data []byte) (map[string]interface{}, error)`

The private token is available through `Token` but must never appear in JSON. Decoding always leaves it empty. A valid device configuration has a label containing at least one non-whitespace character and a level from 0 through 10. Encoding and decoding must reject invalid configurations. Configuration JSON uses exactly the keys `label` and `level`; decoding must reject unknown fields, missing fields, duplicate fields, wrong types, malformed JSON, empty input, and non-whitespace trailing content.

`DecodeJSONObject` accepts any top-level JSON object, including an empty one, and rejects other top-level values, malformed or empty input, and trailing content. Duplicate object keys use the last value. Decode numbers as `json.Number` rather than `float64`. Returned maps and nested values must be newly allocated and must not alias the input byte slice. No function may mutate its input.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.
